## Two Estimates of the 1906 Earthquake

The 1906 earthquake has been assigned different magnitude estimates using different kinds of measurements. One seismic analysis examined recordings from 96 observatories and digitized and modeled usable data from 12, suggesting a surface-wave magnitude of 7.7.

A USGS team later re-evaluated geodetic measurements made before and after the earthquake. This approach used ground deformation recorded in angles and distances between benchmarks and produced an estimate of 7.9.

The estimates come from different measurement methods, which can yield different estimates of an earthquake’s size.
